title: I can’t code or draw, and I built a 21-championship motorsport management sim with AI. Here’s what worked and what didn’t.
author: ANMGP_Studio
selftext:
Automotive Empire started as game that I wanted to play but the available in the market and their mods did not provide. 6 months later it simulates 7 racing disciplines, 21 championships running at the same time, and 172 rival teams that develop their cars, poach staff and fight for sponsors just like you.

What worked:

* I habe used Opus for coding, Grok fro images and Suno for the music
* Coding in Opus made it a reality and Grok and Suno made it feel enjoyable and presentable

What didn’t:

* There were times though that the struggle was huge, like coding the pace behind the Safety Car, making the engine understand different racing strategies and identifying when the AI has started to make mistakes. Also, creating racing tracks in Grok, closed loops, is still a huge nightmare.

My job ended up being creative direction: deciding what the game should feel like and rejecting a lot of output until it did.

I am still working in the game, I expect to have it ready in the coming months.

Happy to answer anything about the workflow. Trailer in the comments if anyone wants to see it running.

replies.author: No_Basil4168
replies.body: I think you’d be better putting effort into the game using whatever skills you do have. Fake team sponsors etc. any features that improve immersion leaving it open to mods to get around licensing. Using AI to produce these weird ass looking videos is the wrong play. They look horrendous and are basically the definition of AI slop now. Instead record actual footage of the game being played and learn some basic video editing skills (or get a good template) and make something that looks professional and like it was made with care not a prompt. Using AI to accelerate and amplify your skills is great, using it as a lazy way to get an end result and you’re just creating generic slop that turns a lot of potential players off. I’m a huge motorsport fan, love F1 Manager, I work in tech and use AI everyday. I’m also using AI in my own projects. I would not download and play this. Take from that what you want.

replies.author: ANMGP_Studio
replies.body:
Fake teams, sponsors, drivers, car parts, RnD, CnC plant, everything exists in the game. I am planning to create also a trailer dedicated to what you describe.   
Thanks again for your feedback and I hope that you will give a try to the demo!
